messages:
Ellen: heads up 1: SAST job on main is failing post-RBAC rollout. Uploads to evidence bucket error out with KMS decrypt denies.
Priya: yep just saw alerts. svc-scan-prod@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com is getting AccessDenied from KMS when trying to decrypt the envelope key.
SecBot: scan-alert: pipeline #5982 failed  unable to decrypt artifact key (cloudkms.AccessDenied). https://ci.internal/pipelines/5982
Marco: minimal log snippet:
```
2026-04-02T09:03:12Z ERROR evidence-uploader: decrypt error: rpc error: code=PermissionDenied desc=\"projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/sast-kr/cryptoKeys/sast-artifact-key: request denied\"
principal=serviceAccount:svc-scan-prod@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com action=kms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt
```
Ravi: this looks like the RBAC change removed roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter from the SA for that key. Short-term fix is to re-add the binding scoped to the key.
Priya: agreed. Example command we can use (least-priv):
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding sast-artifact-key \
  --keyring=sast-kr --location=global \
  --member=serviceAccount:svc-scan-prod@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
```
Ellen: quick question re: auditability 1: will the grant show up in Cloud Audit Logs and be linkable to the incident doc?
Marco: yes. IAM policy change entries plus subsequent kalllogs for KMS.decrypt will be recorded. Capture the PR/CL that applied the RBAC change too.
Priya: longer term: we should add two things before any RBAC rollout that touches scanner roles: (1) a premerge CI check that verifies the scanner SA can decrypt a test key; (2) an automated smoke test run of SAST/DAST in a canary environment after RBAC apply.
Ravi: I'll open PRs for both. For the premerge check I'll add a tiny step in the iam-change CI job that runs this snippet against a test key and fails if decrypt is denied. Pseudocode:
```
# premerge check
gcloud kms decrypt --ciphertext-file=/tmp/ct --plaintext-file=/tmp/pt --location=global --keyring=test-kr --key=test-key --project=redwood-test
# assert exit 0
```
Marco: also consider making the SAST pipeline more tolerant: on KMS decrypt failure upload a redacted artifact (strip secrets) to a quarantined bucket and mark the scan status as "partial" instead of hard-fail. That preserves triage info.
Ellen: DAST note: some DAST authenticated crawls consume tokens from the SAST artifact. If artifact is partial we should trigger a DAST fallback mode (unauthenticated crawl) and schedule a re-run once decrypt is fixed. Add this to the runbook.
Priya: +1. Add a checklist item: "if artifact decrypt fails, fallback to redacted upload + trigger unauthenticated DAST + create incident linkage."
Ravi: will open PRs: (A) IAM binding rollback/grant for prod key, (B) CI premerge decrypt check, (C) SAST pipeline fallback to redacted artifacts. Requesting sec + infra review. ETA EOD.
Marco: I'll prepare the playbook update and example audit collection queries (Cloud Audit Logs filter strings) and attach to the incident doc.
SecBot: incident-created: https://docs.internal/security/incidents/1761001234-sast-kms-decrypt-playbook (auto)
Ellen: thanks all, triage complete for now. Follow-ups: PR-grant, PR-premerge-test, PR-pipeline-fallback, playbook update, audit attach.
Priya: I'll own post-incident verification that the premerge check is enabled across all RBAC change templates.
Ravi: noted, will include test harness and a unit test that simulates AccessDenied to make sure we fail fast during review.
Ellen: closing thread; will link final postmortem to the doc when done.
